notes: P2ID addresses are chain-agnostic: the whole stack is deployed through the deterministic deployment proxy (contracts/scripts/deploy-deterministic.ts), so the factory, and every identity's vault, has the same address on every EVM chain. vaultInitCodeHash = keccak256(P2IDVault creation bytecode) from the Hardhat artifact (solc 0.8.28, optimizer 200 runs, metadata.bytecodeHash none); run `node scripts/embed-p2id.mjs --update` after any vault change. factory = the PviumP2IdVaultFactory address that script prints; null until the first deployment.
